text:
Devon: pd alert storm: `model-inference-high-latency` has been firing ~600 alerts in the last 5m from eu-cluster. PD is paging. User-facing latency +2-3s and error rate up ~5%. I’m taking the page now — anyone else seeing this?
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-314 (service: model-inference). Paging routed to eng-oncall. Link: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/INC-2026-314 :rotating_light:
Anna: on my way. can you paste the query or alert rule so i can check thresholds?
Devon: alert rule: `latency_p99 > 400` (ms) per model_id per region. spikes concentrated in eu-west-1, model family: redwood-llm-v2.
Mike: seeing continuous small bursts from the same 3 nodes in eu-west-1. CPU looks fine but NVCache hit-rate dropped. might be KV cache thrash after the new kernel build last night.
Samir: if it's KV cache thrash we should try removing those nodes from LB, scale replicas, and rehydrate caches. quick mitigation: scale +4 replicas in eu-west pool and temporarily set alert dedupe/squelch for this rule to avoid paging waves.
Anna: +1 to scaling now. also propose a 30m PD suppression to stop repeat pages while we stabilize.
Devon: scaling up now: `infra scale pool inference-eu-west --add 4` (output: accepted).
Ops-Bot: autoscaler started 4 instances for inference-eu-west (instance ids i-0a12.., i-0b34..).
Mike: rebalancing traffic off the 3 noisy nodes: `kubectl cordon noisy-node-1 && kubectl drain noisy-node-1 --ignore-daemonsets`
Samir: applying PD suppression: `/pd-squelch INC-2026-314 --rule "model-inference-high-latency" --duration 30m --reason "live-mitigation scaling + cache rehydrate"`
Oncall Bot: PagerDuty: Squelch applied for 30m. New pages suppressed for rule `model-inference-high-latency`.
Devon: added temporary prometheus alert tweak (in our alertmanager): increased `for` from 1m to 5m for this rule to reduce flapping while we stabilize.
Anna: capturing the prometheus edit here so it’s reproducible:
```yaml
- alert: ModelInferenceHighLatency
  expr: latency_p99{service="inference"} > 0.4
  for: 5m  # temporarily increased from 1m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "P99 latency high for {{ $labels.model_id }}"
```
Mike: after scale + rehydrate, error-rate dropped to baseline and p99 trending down. latency still elevated ~300ms above normal but stable.
Lena: creating quick grafana panel to track node-level KV cache hit rate + p99. putting it under `eng/incident-dashboards/inference-noise` so we can hand off.
Samir: note for postmortem: we need to change alert grouping key so PD doesn’t open hundreds of incidents for the same root cause. current grouping uses instance_id; proposal: group by `region + model_family + alert_rule` instead of instance_id.
Anna: I’ll open a ticket to change Alertmanager and PD grouping: ENG-4471. will propose grouping key: `{{region}}:{{model_family}}:{{alert_name}}`. also add a 30s dedupe window in PD.
Devon: quick customer-impact check: support reports ~12 timed-out requests in last 10m for EU customers (customer-impact low-medium). told accounts team.
Ops-Bot: Incident severity updated to SEV-2 due to elevated user latency across region.
Mike: I recommend also adding an automatic fallback rule that routes traffic to cheaper model variant when KV cache miss spikes > X% to avoid cascading latency. filing FR.
Anna: actions agreed during incident: 1) short-term: 30m PD squelch, increase `for` to 5m, scale +4 nodes, cordon noisy nodes, create incident dashboard. 2) post-incident: change PD grouping key to region+model_family, add PD dedupe window 30s, implement automatic fallback to model-variant when cache miss > threshold, add regression alert for kernel changes.
Samir: i’ll own the PD grouping change PR (ENG-4471). i’ll also add unit tests for grouping key edge cases. ETA tomorrow EOD.
Lena: dashboard created: https://grafana.company/inference-noise-panel; added panels for p99, error-rate, KV-hit, node-traffic. shared with eng-oncall.
Devon: metrics look stable for 12m. i’m going to close the squelch in 10m and monitor.
Oncall Bot: PD Squelch scheduled to expire in 18m.
Anna: follow-up: create a short runbook section in the oncall playbook for KV-cache thrash with step-by-step (scale, cordon/drain, rehydrate, squelch). I'll add to Confluence and link in the ticket.
Samir: PR opened for PD grouping and dedupe config: https://git.company/infra/pd-config/pull/682. requesting review from eng-sre.
Devon: Thanks team. will compile a short incident note and hand off to postmortem. Assigning myself to lead the write-up.
Mike: :thumbsup: great fast work. keep the follow-ups on the ticket so we can close loop in 1 week.
Lena: leaving a short note for support: "brief latency spike in EU caused by KV cache thrash; mitigated by scaling and cache rehydrate; ongoing follow-ups in ENG-4471."
Devon: closing PD incident now since pages stopped and metrics stable. will post the postmortem link here when done.
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: INC-2026-314. duration 42m.
Devon: post-incident tasks recap: Samir -> PD grouping PR, Anna -> runbook & dashboard cleanup, Lena -> attach grafana to runbook, Mike -> investigate kernel change rollback path, Devon -> postmortem + customer impact note.
Anna: tagging @oncall for visibility: we should schedule a tuning window next week to roll these alert changes to prod and watch.
Samir: noted. creating a calendar slot and will invite eng-oncall + eng-sre.
Devon: thanks all. :hands_together:
